//: Azure OpenAI gateway, keyless. Callers authenticate with their own X-CredProx-Key, matched against the SHA-256 KeyHashes under CredProx:Callers; each caller's Operations list is its deployment allow-list (Azure OpenAI names the deployment in the path, so a Paths rule per deployment pattern IS the allow-list; absent list = every deployment). CredProx authenticates upstream with a short-lived Microsoft Entra token from the TokenCredential type — the managed identity when deployed, the az sign-in locally — and no API key exists anywhere. Demo caller keys are throwaway.

Metrics.//: Console true prints the CredProx meter to stdout instead of exporting OTLP (the default endpoint OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT). Shorten OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL (ms, default 60000) for demos.
